guide.section.adv.body: Press the ‘Advanced Action Setup’ button next to Action Priority to open it. There are three tabs — Turn timeline (set who acts, in what order and with what action, turn by turn), EX Skill policy (when each companion uses its EX Skill) and Sync (align other companions' actions to one companion's EX Skill turn). Only the Turn timeline tab has an ‘Enable’ switch; the other two tabs always apply.
guide.section.altar.item: Star Altar — penalties from unlit altars (less healing received, higher max EX Skill CD, etc.) apply in battle. Moon Altar — buffs from lit altars apply in battle.
guide.section.altar.item2: Floors can be lit only in order from floor 1, and lighting an upper floor also lights the floors below. Each effect can be turned on or off individually.
guide.section.cond.item3: Iterations — used to find the median. Higher is more accurate but slower
guide.section.intro.intro: A simulator that calculates a 5-companion team's damage turn by turn.
guide.section.stats.body: Shows total damage, DPS and turn count, plus a bar ranking of damage per companion. Each value comes with the median and the chance range (no chance effects trigger – all trigger).
